rationale: The candidate reads as one coherent massing family across the four views, so it avoids the worst multi-view collision problem and has a clear dominant gesture. The stepped/tapered top gives a legible silhouette, but the form still leans toward an abstracted object rather than a strongly programed neighborhood-building section. The main weakness is the public threshold: the blue access edge is not answered by a convincing ground court, undercut, or porous seam, so the street response remains semantically thin. The references support this reading: the restaurant precedents reinforce active edge and courtyard logic, while the tower/bridge precedents are only cautionary or loosely transferable. Overall the mass is plausible but not yet program-strong enough for neighborhood living because the ground/public void relationship is underdeveloped.
